general_information.Description: This course covering basic to advanced digital concepts with an emphasis on problem solving, troubleshooting, and applications. Assessment scheme: 1) On-going asessment: - 03 Quizzes: 30% - 01 Assignment: 20% - Excercises: 10% 2) Final exam: 40% 3) Final Result: 100% Completion Criteria: 1) Every on-going assessment component >0 2) Final Exam Score >=4 & Final Result >=5
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Usually access http://bigdatauniversity.com/ for downloading materials and reading
general_information.Tools: Technical facilities: Electronics basic components, Logic gates, Combinational Digital Ics

constructive_questions.Details: What do you know about the Digital and Analog systems? What is the Binary system? Why do we need to use it? What are basis logic function?

Can you tell the difference of the programable logic device and the Fixed fuction logic devices? Why do we need the test and measurement instruments? Can you name some of them? Why do we need the trouble shooting process? How does it deployed?

What are the decimal numbers? Binary numbers? How can we change a number from decimal to binary? How can we oprate binary arithmetic? How many forms of complemetnts of binary number? How to describe sign numbers?
How can we deploy Arithmetic Operations with Signed Numbers in binary system? What do you know about hexadecimal numbers? octal numbers? BCD? What are digital codes? Error codes?
What is the inverter? How do the And, and Or gate operate? How do the NAnd, and NOr gate operate?

What is the difference of The Exclusive-OR and Exclusive-NOR Gates? How do them operate? How can we create progrmable logic devices? Can you describes the main techs of programable devices? Could you descirbed the properties of the Fixed function logic gates?

Why do we need the bool operations and expresstions? What are Laws and Rules of Boolean Algebra? What are DeMorgan’s Theorems? How can we analysis of logic circuits? How to simplify the bool algebra? What is the standart form?
What is the truth table? What is it use for? How to use it? How to minimize Karnaugh map using POS? SOP? What is the McCluskey method? How to apply it? What is VHDL
What are the basic Combinational Logic Circuits? How to implement them? Can we use one logic gate to describe the others? If yes, listing them? How to do that?
What is the pulse wave form operation? How to describe combination logic using VHDL? What is Trobleshooting?

How can we do the add operation in the binary system? What is the difference of half and full adder? How can we operate parallel binary adding? Why are Ripple Carry and Look-Ahead Carry Adders important? How can we compare number in the binary system? What is a comparator? How does it operate? What are decoders and encoders? Why do we need them?
What are code converters? Why do we need them? Why do we use multiplexers and demuntiplexers? How to describe them ? Why do we use parity? What are odd and even parity? How to create them?
What are latches? What are they used for? How many kind of them? What are FFs? How are they differrence from the latches? How many kind of them? What are they used for?
What is oneshot? What is the anstable multivibratior? How do they differ? What are the appliacitons of oneshots? anstable multivibrator? How can we construct a timer?
What are finite state machines? What are asyncronos counter? whay do we need sychonous counters? What are up-down sychronous counters? how to design them?
What are cascaded counters? How to decode counters? Why do we need counters?
What are Shift Register Operations? Types of Shift Register Data I/Os? How do Bidirectional Shift Registers work ? What are Shift Register Counters?
Why do we need shift register? How to describe Logic Symbols with Dependency Notation
Why do we need the data storage devices? What do you know about RAM,? How many kinds of Rams? What are the pros and cons of them?
What are the differeces of ROM and RAM? What do you know about others storage devices? Which fieds do we use storage devices?
What do you know about computers? What are they constructed of? What is a cpu? What are CPU architectures?
How can a Microprocessors execute programs ? What do you know about 8088? Why do we need to lear about it? How can a 8088 operate?
